description: This source file contains utility functions for handling JSON data and text files, converting between JSON structures and custom etree.Node representations, and reading/writing files. It appears to serve as a utility module for JSON and file parsing tasks within a larger project.

methods.name: splitIntoLines
methods.description: Splits a string content into a slice of lines based on newline characters.

methods.name: convertJSONToNodes
methods.description: Recursively converts unmarshaled JSON data into a slice of etree.Node objects, handling objects, arrays, and primitive types.

methods.name: readJSONFile
methods.description: Reads a JSON file from the specified path, unmarshals its contents, and converts it into a slice of etree.Node.

methods.name: convertNodesToJSON
methods.description: Converts an etree.Node structure back into a generic interface{} suitable for JSON marshaling.

methods.name: readDPPUriTxtFileToNodes
methods.description: Reads a text file, wraps its contents in a JSON structure with a URI key, and converts it into etree.Node slices.

methods.name: writeJSONFile
methods.description: Serializes an etree.Node structure into JSON format and writes it to a specified file.
